## Definitions

- **mirrored**: an MCP tool dispatches the owning script (or derives from it);
  py/ts marks come from `manifest/FEATURES.yaml`. `stale` means upstream removed
  the owning script after the pin — the tool still dispatches the old name.
- **denied-by-design**: `adapter/dispatch.py` DENY_LIST refuses the surface with
  `forbidden`; the reason names the smarts-only line that keeps it out.
- **gap**: reachable upstream surface with no tool and no refusal entry —
  explicitly unmirrored, not silently omitted. Gaps are the port backlog.
